features.title: TXT and Plain Text Input
features.description: Paste plain text into the editor or open a local .txt, .csv, .tsv, .text, or .log file. The file is read in your browser and never uploaded.

features.title: Lines to JSON Array
features.description: Turn one item per line into a JSON array, in the original input order. Empty lines can be skipped and duplicate values can be removed while keeping the position of the first occurrence.

features.title: Key-Value Text to Object
features.description: Parse lines such as name: Alice or name=Alice into a JSON object. The line is split at the first separator only, so url: https://example.com/a:b keeps the full URL as its value.

features.title: Delimited Text to Records
features.description: Convert comma-, tab-, semicolon-, or pipe-separated text into a JSON array of objects, with auto-detection available. Use the first row as headers, or let the tool name the columns column_1, column_2, and so on.

features.title: Preview and Parsing Warnings
features.description: Review the first 10 parsed lines, key-value entries, or data rows before exporting. Duplicate keys, skipped lines, and rows with a different number of columns are reported in the preview.

features.title: Optional Type Inference
features.description: When enabled, lowercase true and false become booleans and plain integers or decimals such as 30 or 1.5 become numbers. It is off by default, so values such as 00123, 1.10, TRUE, and NULL stay strings.

features.title: Copy JSON Output
features.description: Copy the generated JSON to the clipboard for use in scripts, APIs, configuration files, test fixtures, or frontend applications. The copy always contains every parsed item, not just the previewed ones.

features.title: Download JSON File
features.description: Download the full result as a .json file after reviewing the parsed structure and warnings.

features.title: Browser-Based Processing
features.description: Text parsing and JSON generation happen in your browser. No account is required and the input text is not sent to a remote conversion service.

guide.title: Paste or open text
guide.description: Paste plain text into the input editor or open a local .txt file. The input can be a line list, key-value text, or a delimited table.

guide.title: Choose a parsing mode
guide.description: Select Lines to JSON array for one item per line, Key-value text to object for key/value records, or Delimited text to objects for table-like data. Loading a built-in example switches the mode for you.

guide.description: The available options depend on the mode: the delimiter and header switch appear in delimited mode, the key separator appears in key-value mode, and skip empty lines and remove duplicate lines apply to line and key-value text. Type inference, empty-value, trim, and indent options are always available.

guide.description: Check the detected lines, keys, rows, and columns together with any duplicate-key, skipped-line, or uneven-row warnings before creating the final JSON.

guide.title: Convert and export
guide.description: Click Convert to JSON, then copy the result or download it as a .json file. The output also updates automatically while you type, so you can adjust the options and watch the result change. Validate the output before sending it to another system.

faq.question: What does this TXT to JSON converter do?
faq.answer: It converts plain text into JSON using a parsing mode you choose. Lines to JSON array turns one item per line into a JSON array, Key-value text to object turns key/value lines into a single JSON object, and Delimited text to objects turns table-like text into an array of JSON objects.

faq.question: Can I convert a TXT file to JSON?
faq.answer: Yes. Open a .txt, .csv, .tsv, .text, or .log file from your device, or paste its contents. Then choose the parsing mode that matches the file, review the preview, and copy or download the generated JSON.

faq.question: How do I convert a list of lines to a JSON array?
faq.answer: Choose Lines to JSON array and paste one value per line. Three lines containing Alice, Bob, and Charlie become ["Alice", "Bob", "Charlie"]. The array keeps the original input order.

faq.question: Can I convert key-value text to JSON?
faq.answer: Yes. Choose Key-value text to object and use lines such as name: Alice or name=Alice. The line is split at the first separator only, so a line such as url: https://example.com/a:b produces the key url with the full URL as its value.

faq.question: Which key separators are supported?
faq.answer: Colon (:) and equals (=). Select the one that matches your input. Lines without the selected separator are skipped and counted in the preview instead of failing the whole conversion.

faq.question: Can I convert CSV-like text to JSON?
faq.answer: Yes. Choose Delimited text to objects, select the delimiter, and indicate whether the first row contains headers. Each data row becomes one JSON object.

faq.question: Which delimiters are supported?
faq.answer: Comma, tab, semicolon, and pipe, plus auto-detection. Auto-detection scores each candidate by how consistently it splits the first rows into the same number of columns, so choose the delimiter manually when the input is ambiguous or when a delimiter also appears inside values.

faq.question: Does it support quoted values?
faq.answer: Yes in delimited mode. A field wrapped in double quotes may contain the delimiter and line breaks, and two consecutive double quotes inside a quoted field represent one literal double quote.

faq.question: Can I convert text without a header row?
faq.answer: Yes. Turn off First row is header and the converter names the columns column_1, column_2, column_3, and so on. A blank cell inside a header row falls back to the same generated name.

faq.question: Does it infer numbers and booleans?
faq.answer: Only when Infer basic types is enabled, and only for a narrow set of values: lowercase true and false become booleans, and plain integers or decimals such as 30, -7, or 1.5 become numbers. Values such as TRUE, NULL, 1e5, .5, +5, 00123, 1.10, and 2026-09-18 stay strings. Keep the option off when identifiers, postal codes, version strings, or formatted values must remain text.

faq.question: What happens to empty lines and empty values?
faq.answer: In line and key-value mode, Skip empty lines is on by default and removes blank lines. Empty values become empty strings, or null when Convert empty values to null is enabled. In delimited mode, blank lines are dropped by the parser and missing cells become empty values.

faq.question: What happens when duplicate keys appear?
faq.answer: The converter reports how many duplicate keys were found and keeps the last value for that key. The key itself stays at the position of its first appearance, because a JSON object cannot hold two separate properties with the same name.

faq.question: Can I remove duplicate lines?
faq.answer: Yes. In Lines to JSON array mode, turn on Remove duplicate lines. The first occurrence keeps its position and later duplicates are dropped, so the remaining order still follows the input.

faq.question: Can I convert indented text to nested JSON?
faq.answer: No. Indented or hierarchy text is not supported because indentation rules are ambiguous. Flatten the text into one item per line, key-value pairs, or delimited rows, and then convert it.

faq.question: Can I convert ChatGPT or AI-generated text to JSON?
faq.answer: Only when the text follows a recognizable structure such as one item per line, key-value pairs, or a consistent delimiter. This page is not a natural-language parser and does not guess field names or schemas from prose.

faq.question: Can I convert text to JSON Lines?
faq.answer: No. This page outputs a JSON array for line and delimited input, or a JSON object for key-value input. There is no JSONL output mode.

faq.question: Does the preview limit the exported JSON?
faq.answer: No. The preview shows the first 10 parsed lines, key-value entries, or data rows so you can check the parsing rules quickly. Copy and download always use every parsed item.

faq.question: Can I convert a large TXT file?
faq.answer: The practical limit depends on file size, number of lines, browser memory, parsing mode, and preview rendering. Very large files may be slow to render in the editor, in which case a local parser or command-line tool is a better fit.

faq.question: Is my text uploaded to a server?
faq.answer: No. The page reads the input and generates JSON in your browser. You should still avoid entering passwords, access tokens, private customer data, or confidential production text into any browser-based tool.

faq.question: Is this a free TXT to JSON converter?
faq.answer: Yes. You can paste or open text, choose a parsing mode, review the output, and copy or download JSON without creating an account.

article.title: How to Convert TXT and Plain Text to JSON
article.content:
What Is TXT to JSON Conversion?

TXT to JSON conversion turns unstructured or semi-structured text into a JSON object or array. Unlike a fixed file-format conversion, plain text does not define one universal structure, so the converter has to apply explicit parsing rules.

A line list, a key-value file, and a CSV-like table are all text, but they should produce different JSON shapes. Choosing the correct parsing mode matters more than changing the file extension.

Choose the Right Parsing Mode

  • Lines to array: use when each non-empty line is one string value.
  • Key-value text: use when each line holds a key and a value separated by a colon or an equals sign.
  • Delimited rows: use when the text has columns separated by commas, tabs, semicolons, or pipes.

Convert Lines to a JSON Array

Input:

Alice
Bob
Charlie

Output:

["Alice", "Bob", "Charlie"]

This mode suits lists of IDs, URLs, emails, tags, and keywords. The array keeps the input order, and Remove duplicate lines drops later duplicates while keeping the first occurrence in place.

Convert Key-Value Text to a JSON Object

Input:

name: Alice
age: 30
active: true

Output with Infer basic types enabled:

{
  "name": "Alice",
  "age": 30,
  "active": true
}

With the option off, which is the default, the output is:

{
  "name": "Alice",
  "age": "30",
  "active": "true"
}

Key-value parsing splits each line at the first separator only. A line such as url: https://example.com/a:b yields the key url and the value https://example.com/a:b, rather than breaking the URL apart. Lines with no separator, or with an empty key, are skipped and counted in the preview instead of failing the conversion.

Convert Delimited Text to JSON Records

Input:

name,age,city
Alice,30,New York
Bob,25,London

Output:

[
  {"name":"Alice","age":"30","city":"New York"},
  {"name":"Bob","age":"25","city":"London"}
]

Use a CSV-compatible parser when fields can contain delimiters, escaped quotes, or line breaks. In delimited mode, quoted fields are supported: a value wrapped in double quotes may contain the delimiter and line breaks, and two consecutive double quotes inside it represent one literal quote. A simple split on the delimiter is not sufficient for that kind of data.

Type Inference Can Change Values

Plain text carries no reliable type system. This converter only infers a narrow set of values, and only when Infer basic types is enabled: lowercase true and false become booleans, and plain integers or decimals matching -?\d+ or -?\d+\.\d+ become numbers.

  • Leading zeros: 00123 stays the string "00123".
  • Version strings: 1.10 would lose its trailing zero as a number, so it stays text when inference is off.
  • Uppercase and null-like text: TRUE, FALSE, and NULL are not recognized and stay strings.
  • Scientific notation: 1e5 is not recognized and stays a string.
  • Dates and postal codes: these are treated as text unless you enable inference and they happen to match the numeric patterns.

Keep type inference disabled when preserving the exact source text matters more than convenience.

Headers and Uneven Rows

Delimited input may contain a header row, missing values, extra values, or blank headers. When First row is header is off, or a header cell is blank, the converter generates the names column_1, column_2, and so on. Rows with a different number of columns are highlighted in the preview and reported as a warning; the conversion still runs, missing cells become empty values, and extra values beyond the column count are ignored.

Text to JSON Is Not Natural-Language Understanding

Plain text can be ambiguous. A paragraph, a log file, a Markdown document, or an AI response cannot become a meaningful JSON structure without rules. Use an explicit pattern such as one item per line, key-value pairs, or a consistent delimiter. For AI-generated output, first make sure it follows a predictable structure.

TXT to JSON vs JSON String Parsing

TXT to JSON can mean several things. This page handles structured plain text and text files. If the input is already a JSON-encoded string such as "{\"name\":\"Alice\"}", use a JSON unescape workflow instead. If the input is an ordinary JSON document, use a JSON formatter or validator rather than a text converter.

TXT to JSON vs JSONL

A JSON array stores many values inside one JSON document. JSON Lines stores one JSON value per line. This page outputs a JSON array or a JSON object and does not provide a JSONL output mode, so if a downstream system needs JSONL, convert it with a separate step.

Privacy and Browser-Based Processing

This converter reads text and generates JSON in the browser rather than uploading the input to a remote service. That is useful for internal lists and development data, but it is not a secret-management system. Avoid entering credentials, tokens, private customer records, or confidential production text into any online tool.

When to Use a Local Parser

For very large files, repeatable data pipelines, strict CSV compatibility, confidential data, or automated processing, use a local parser or command-line workflow. Browser conversion is best suited to quick transformations, inspection, and small-to-medium inputs.

faq.question: 这个 TXT 转 JSON 转换器做什么？
faq.answer: 它按你选择的解析模式把纯文本转换成 JSON：「每行转 JSON 数组」把一行一个值转成数组，「键值文本转对象」把键值行转成单个 JSON 对象，「分隔文本转对象」把表格类文本转成 JSON 对象数组。

faq.question: 能把 TXT 文件转成 JSON 吗？
faq.answer: 可以。从本地打开 .txt、.csv、.tsv、.text 或 .log 文件，也可以直接粘贴内容。然后选择匹配文件的解析模式，查看预览，再复制或下载生成的 JSON。

faq.question: 怎么把多行文本转成 JSON 数组？
faq.answer: 选择「每行转 JSON 数组」，粘贴一行一个值。包含 Alice、Bob、Charlie 的三行会变成 ["Alice", "Bob", "Charlie"]，数组顺序与输入顺序一致。

faq.question: 能把键值文本转成 JSON 吗？
faq.answer: 可以。选择「键值文本转对象」，使用 name: Alice 或 name=Alice 这样的行。只在第一个分隔符处切分，所以 url: https://example.com/a:b 会得到键 url 和完整的 URL 值。

faq.question: 支持哪些键值分隔符？
faq.answer: 冒号 (:) 和等号 (=)，选择与你的输入匹配的那一个。没有该分隔符的行会被跳过并在预览里计数，不会导致整次转换失败。

faq.question: 能把类 CSV 文本转成 JSON 吗？
faq.answer: 可以。选择「分隔文本转对象」，选择分隔符，并指定第一行是否为表头。每一行数据会成为一个 JSON 对象。

faq.question: 支持哪些分隔符？
faq.answer: 逗号、制表符、分号和竖线，另外还有自动检测。自动检测按「能否把前几行稳定切成相同列数」打分，所以输入有歧义、或分隔符也出现在值里面时，请手动选择分隔符。

faq.question: 支持带引号的值吗？
faq.answer: 分隔模式支持。双引号包裹的字段里可以包含分隔符和换行，字段内连续两个双引号表示一个真正的双引号。

faq.question: 没有表头行也能转换吗？
faq.answer: 可以。关掉「第一行是表头」，转换器会把列命名为 column_1、column_2、column_3 等。表头行里的空单元格也会回落到同样的生成名称。

faq.question: 会推断数字和布尔值吗？
faq.answer: 只有开启「推断基础类型」时才会，而且范围很窄：小写的 true 和 false 变成布尔值，30、-7、1.5 这样的整数或小数变成数字。TRUE、NULL、1e5、.5、+5、00123、1.10、2026-09-18 都保持字符串。如果 ID、邮编、版本号或带格式的值必须保持文本，请不要开启这个选项。

faq.question: 空行和空值怎么处理？
faq.answer: 在行列表和键值模式下，「跳过空行」默认开启，会去掉空行。空值会变成空字符串；开启「空值转成 null」时变成 null。在分隔模式下，解析器会丢弃空行，缺失的单元格变成空值。

faq.question: 出现重复键会怎样？
faq.answer: 转换器会提示发现多少个重复键，并保留该键最后一次的值。键本身仍停在首次出现的位置，因为 JSON 对象不能有两个同名属性。

faq.question: 能去除重复行吗？
faq.answer: 可以。在「每行转 JSON 数组」模式下开启「去除重复行」。首次出现的行保留在原位置，后面的重复项被丢弃，剩余顺序仍与输入一致。

faq.question: 能把缩进文本转成嵌套 JSON 吗？
faq.answer: 不能。缩进层级文本的规则有歧义，本页不支持。请先把文本整理成一行一个值、键值对或分隔行，再进行转换。

faq.question: 能把 ChatGPT 或 AI 生成的文本转成 JSON 吗？
faq.answer: 只有在文本本身有可识别结构时才可以，比如一行一个值、键值对或统一的分隔符。本页不是自然语言解析器，不会从一段文字里猜字段名或结构。

faq.question: 能把文本转成 JSON Lines 吗？
faq.answer: 不能。本页在行列表和分隔模式下输出 JSON 数组，在键值模式下输出 JSON 对象，没有 JSONL 输出模式。

faq.question: 预览会限制导出的 JSON 吗？
faq.answer: 不会。预览只显示前 10 条解析结果，方便快速检查解析规则。复制和下载始终包含全部解析结果。

faq.question: 能转换很大的 TXT 文件吗？
faq.answer: 实际能处理多大取决于文件大小、行数、浏览器内存、解析模式和预览渲染。很大的文件在编辑器里可能会卡，这种情况更适合用本地解析器或命令行工具。

faq.question: 我的文本会被上传到服务器吗？
faq.answer: 不会。本页在你的浏览器里读取输入并生成 JSON。但仍然不要把密码、访问令牌、客户隐私数据或生产环境的机密文本粘贴到任何在线工具里。

faq.question: 这个 TXT 转 JSON 转换器免费吗？
faq.answer: 免费。粘贴或打开文本、选择解析模式、查看结果、复制或下载 JSON，都不需要注册账号。

article.title: 如何把 TXT 和纯文本转换成 JSON
article.content:
什么是 TXT 转 JSON

TXT 转 JSON 是把无结构或半结构化文本转换成 JSON 对象或数组的过程。和固定文件格式转换不同，纯文本本身没有统一结构，所以转换器必须应用明确的解析规则。

行列表、键值文件和类 CSV 表格都是文本，但它们应该生成完全不同的 JSON 形状。选对解析模式比改文件后缀重要得多。

选择合适的解析模式

  • 每行转数组：每个非空行是一个字符串值。
  • 键值文本：每行是用冒号或等号分隔的键和值。
  • 分隔行：文本里有按逗号、制表符、分号或竖线分隔的列。

把行列表转换成 JSON 数组

输入：

Alice
Bob
Charlie

输出：

["Alice", "Bob", "Charlie"]

这个模式适合 ID、URL、邮箱、标签、关键词这类列表。数组保持输入顺序；开启「去除重复行」时会丢掉后面的重复项，首次出现的位置不变。

把键值文本转换成 JSON 对象

输入：

name: Alice
age: 30
active: true

开启「推断基础类型」时的输出：

{
  "name": "Alice",
  "age": 30,
  "active": true
}

默认关闭该选项时，输出是：

{
  "name": "Alice",
  "age": "30",
  "active": "true"
}

键值解析只在第一个分隔符处切分。url: https://example.com/a:b 会得到键 url 和值 https://example.com/a:b，而不会把 URL 拆开。没有分隔符或键为空的行会被跳过并在预览里计数，不会让整次转换失败。

把分隔文本转换成 JSON 记录

输入：

name,age,city
Alice,30,New York
Bob,25,London

输出：

[
  {"name":"Alice","age":"30","city":"New York"},
  {"name":"Bob","age":"25","city":"London"}
]

当字段里可能出现分隔符、转义引号或换行时，必须使用兼容 CSV 的解析器。分隔模式支持带引号的字段：双引号包裹的值里可以包含分隔符和换行，连续两个双引号表示一个真正的双引号。这种数据不能靠简单地按分隔符切分来处理。

类型推断会改变值

纯文本没有可靠的类型系统。本转换器只在开启「推断基础类型」时推断很窄的一类值：小写的 true 和 false 变成布尔值，符合 -?\d+ 或 -?\d+\.\d+ 的整数或小数变成数字。

  • 前导零：00123 保持字符串 "00123"。
  • 版本号：1.10 转成数字会丢掉末尾的 0，所以关闭推断时它保持文本。
  • 大写与空值样式的文本：TRUE、FALSE、NULL 都不识别，保持字符串。
  • 科学计数法：1e5 不识别，保持字符串。
  • 日期和邮编：除非开启推断且恰好匹配数字格式，否则按文本处理。

当保留原始文本比方便更重要时，请不要开启类型推断。

表头与行列不齐

分隔文本可能有表头行，也可能有缺失值、多余值或空表头。关闭「第一行是表头」，或表头单元格为空时，转换器会生成 column_1、column_2 这样的列名。列数与其他行不一致的行会在预览里高亮并给出警告；转换仍会执行，缺失的单元格变成空值，超出列数的多余值被忽略。

文本转 JSON 不是自然语言理解

纯文本本身有歧义。一段话、日志文件、Markdown 文档或 AI 回答，不可能在没有规则的情况下变成有意义的 JSON 结构。请使用明确的模式：一行一个值、键值对或统一的分隔符。对于 AI 生成的输出，先确保它遵循可预测的结构。

TXT 转 JSON 与 JSON 字符串解析的区别

「TXT 转 JSON」可能指几件不同的事。本页处理的是结构化的纯文本和文本文件。如果输入已经是 JSON 编码的字符串，例如 "{\"name\":\"Alice\"}"，请改用 JSON 反转义的流程。如果输入本身就是普通的 JSON 文档，请用 JSON 格式化或验证工具，而不是文本转换器。

TXT 转 JSON 与 JSONL 的区别

JSON 数组把很多值放在一个 JSON 文档里；JSON Lines 是每行一个 JSON 值。本页输出 JSON 数组或 JSON 对象，不提供 JSONL 输出模式，所以下游系统需要 JSONL 时要再单独转换一步。

隐私与浏览器本地处理

本转换器在你的浏览器里读取文本并生成 JSON，不会把输入上传到远程服务。这对内部清单和开发数据很方便，但它不是密钥管理系统。不要把凭证、令牌、客户隐私数据或生产环境机密文本粘贴到任何在线工具里。

什么时候改用本地解析器

处理超大文件、可重复的数据管道、严格的 CSV 兼容要求、机密数据或自动化处理时，请用本地解析器或命令行流程。浏览器转换更适合快速处理、查看和小到中等体积的输入。
